steps.title: Find the two eligible subcategories
steps.change: Percent signs are wildcards in LIKE. The substring cookie also matches Cookies, and chocolate matches longer labels such as Dark Chocolate. Tea Biscuit drops out. Products is the only source because Product, Sub_Category and Sale_Price needed for the filters and result all belong to catalogue rows.
steps.added_sql:
select `ProductID`,Product,Sub_Category,Sale_Price
from Products
where ( trim(lower(Sub_Category)) like "%cookie%" or  trim(lower(Sub_Category)) like "%chocolate%")
order by ProductID;
steps.sql:
select `ProductID`,Product,Sub_Category,Sale_Price
from Products
where ( trim(lower(Sub_Category)) like "%cookie%" or  trim(lower(Sub_Category)) like "%chocolate%")
order by ProductID;

steps.title: Apply the price boundary
steps.change: AND applies the price test to the entire parenthesized OR. All three remaining sample rows pass this check. A chocolate item priced exactly 250 fails.
steps.added_sql: where ( trim(lower(Sub_Category)) like "%cookie%" or  trim(lower(Sub_Category)) like "%chocolate%")  and `Sale_Price` < 250
steps.sql:
select `ProductID`,Product,Sub_Category,Sale_Price
from Products
where ( trim(lower(Sub_Category)) like "%cookie%" or  trim(lower(Sub_Category)) like "%chocolate%")  and `Sale_Price` < 250
order by ProductID;

steps.title: Exclude sugar-free names and sort
steps.change: Sugar-free Choc passes the category and price checks and must still be excluded. The product ID settles a price tie.
steps.added_sql:
where ( trim(lower(Sub_Category)) like "%cookie%" or  trim(lower(Sub_Category)) like "%chocolate%")  and `Sale_Price` < 250 and `Product` not like "%sugar-free%"
order by `Sale_Price` asc, `ProductID` asc
